主要内容: On June 16, 2014, SanDisk Corporation entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Fusion-io, Inc. The merger involves SanDisk acquiring Fusion-io, a Delaware corporation. The transaction is part of SanDisk's strategy to expand its presence in the semiconductor and memory industry. SanDisk Corp has agreed to commence a cash tender offer to purchase all of the issued and outstanding shares of the common stock of Fusion-io at a price of $11.25 per share. The offer will expire at midnight New York time on the 20th business day following the commencement date. If successful, the offer will be followed by a merger of Purchaser with and into Fusion-io, with Fusion-io continuing as the surviving corporation and a subsidiary of SanDisk. The agreement includes a termination fee of $42 million if the merger is not completed by October 16, 2014. SanDisk also signed support agreements with certain stockholders of Fusion-io, requiring them to tender their shares, which represent approximately 7% of outstanding shares.
